SABARAGAMUWA PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
THIRD SUPPLEMENTARY FINANCIAL STATEMENT
Authorization

I, do hereby grant Permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Officers of the Sabaragamuwa Province ProvincialCouncil to disburse as per the Third supplementary financial statement for the year 2018, by virtue of powers vested in meunder Section 27 (a) of the Provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Province ProvincialCouncil of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017.

The expenditure of the Sabaragamuwa Province Provincial Council which is estimated Rupees Thirty Billion Five Hundredand Forty Two Million Two Thousand Only (Rs. 30,542,002,000.00) for the service of the period beginning on 01st of January,2018 and ending 31st December, 2018, which is specified in annual financial statement - 2018 (amended) is hereby amended as,Rupees Thirty Billion Five Hundred and Seventy Nine Million, Five Hundred and Fifty Four Thousand Six Hundred and EightyOne Cents Eighty Seven Only (Rs. 30,579,554,681.87) and grant permission to disburse the same from the SabaragamuwaProvince Provincial Council Fund.

This permission will be valid till 31st of December, 2018 or upto the date that expires 03 months from the date of summoningthe 07th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Province ProvincialCouncil which occurs first.
NILUKA EKANAYAKE,Honourable Governor,Sabaragamuwa Province.
12th day of September, 2018.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

GRANTING PERMISSION BY VIRTUE OF POWERS VESTED IN ME UNDER SECTION 27(A) OFPROVINCIAL COUNCIL ACT, No. 42 OF 1987 AS THE TERM OF THE SIXTH SABARAGAMUWA PROVINCEPROVINCIAL COUNCIL OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA ENDED ON 26TH
SEPTEMBER, 2017.
1. This permission may be cited as ‘‘ Permission to disburse under second financial statement - 2018 of the SabaragamuwaProvincial Council’’ and come in to operation from 12.09.2018.

2. The expenditure of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which is estimated Rupees Thirty Billion Five Hundred andForty Two Million, Two Thousand only (Rs. 30,542,002,000.00) for the service of the period beginning on 01st of January,2018 and ending 31st December, 2018, which is specified in 2nd paragraph of Gazette Notification No. 2052/15 dated03.01.2018 which was amended by second supplementary financial statement-2018 dated 24.07.2018, is hereby amendedas, Rupees Thirty Billion Five Hundred and Seventy Nine Million , Five Hundred and Fifty Four Thousand Six Hundredand Eighty One Cents Eighty Seven Only, (Rs. 30,579,554,681.87) and grant permission to the Chief Secretary of thisProvince and other Accounting Officers to disburse the same from the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund.
Accordingly the first schedule of the said Gazette notification is amended as the first schedule hereof and grantpermission to disburse the same.

3. This permission will be valid till 31st of December, 2018 or upto the date that expires three months (03) from the date ofsummoning the Seventh (07th) Sabaragamuwa Province Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of theSabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs first.
